title: Sam Did Not Quit
lines: Sam has a big job. He digs a pit.
The mud is wet. The sun is hot.
Sam digs a lot. Sam gets hot.
Dad digs. Sam digs. We can not quit.
Sam hits a tin box in the mud.
Sam tugs the lid up. It is a map!
Sam is not sad. Sam did not quit!
Dad pats Sam. It is a big job.
We can dig up a lot!

questions.ask: What was in the tin box?
questions.listenFor: A map. It is said in the story. Have your child find the line and read it back so they can show you they know.

questions.ask: Why did Sam want to quit?
questions.listenFor: Digging was hard - the mud was wet, the sun was hot, and he got hot. Any one of those reasons counts.

questions.ask: Do you think Sam was glad he kept going? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: No wrong answer. You are listening for a reason from the story - he found the map, or Dad patted him. The because is what you want.
